newsitem.title: CANADA: Mitec Telecom rises in thin trading.
newsitem.headline: Mitec Telecom rises in thin trading.

text.p: Shares of Mitec Telecom Inc rose 2.10 to 11.45 on the Toronto Stock Exchange on Monday in thin trading.

Analysts said the company, which has nine million shares outstanding, was rising from lows reached in early May, and might be aided by market enthusiasm for companies involved in the growing wireless telecommications industry.
"It was kind of hanging low for a while and is getting back to earlier levels of valuation. I don't think that is too exceptional," said an analyst who did not want to be identified.
Mitec's 52-week high of 12 came in late February.
"When you have a stock that is so thinly traded, it doesn't take that much demand to bring the price back up," the analyst said.
Mitec designs and manufactures components, subsystems and multifunction systems for wireless telecommunications.
